name: base_units_by_name
note: ProductBaseUnit._order = 'name' (addons/product/models/product_base_unit.py:7): the Many2one dropdown for product_template.base_unit_id lists units ordered by the translated name; whole population
source_sql: SELECT id, name->>'en_US' AS name FROM product_base_unit ORDER BY name->>'en_US', id

name: base_unit_count
note: count of custom price-per-unit units (product_product.base_unit_name, addons/product/models/product_product.py:645 reads base_unit_id.name)
source_sql: SELECT count(*) AS units, count(DISTINCT name->>'en_US') AS distinct_names FROM product_base_unit
